| [`add_acl_rule`](https://developers.google.com/workspace/calendar/api/v3/reference/acl/insert) ⚠️ | REST Method | Share a calendar by adding a rule to its access control list, granting a role (none, freeBusyReader, reader, writerWithoutPrivateAccess, writer, or owner) to a scope (a user, a group, a domain, or the public). | [`update_acl_rule`](https://developers.google.com/workspace/calendar/api/v3/reference/acl/update) ⚠️ | REST Method | Replace a rule on a calendar's access control list, setting the role granted to a scope. | [`delete_acl_rule`](https://developers.google.com/workspace/calendar/api/v3/reference/acl/delete) ⚠️ | REST Method | Revoke a rule from a calendar's access control list, removing that scope's access to the calendar. The grantee is not notified. |
